files.name: IBD_2020_codified_raw_fake_data.csv

columns.name: PATIENT_NUM
columns.demo_rule: 200 generated IDs. Same patient as Patient_num in monthly files. Actual R storage type not verified.

columns.name: ENCOUNTER_NUM
columns.meaning: Encounter identifier used to link encounter information. 就诊编号。
columns.demo_rule: Three encounter IDs per synthetic patient. Each encounter belongs to one patient.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.meaning: Start date of the code occurrence. 代码记录的开始日期。
columns.demo_rule: Synthetic dates from 2019-01-01 to 2025-12-01. Actual source date storage type not verified.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.meaning: End date of the code occurrence. May be missing, same as start, or later. 结束日期可缺失、与开始日期相同或更晚。
columns.demo_rule: 55% NA, 35% same day, 10% later by 1–30 days. Demonstration probabilities, not measured source statistics.

columns.name: CONCEPT_CD
columns.meaning: Concept or local code. May include ICD10, RXNORM, ERX, EPRC, PheCode, or provider-related values. 概念或本地代码。
columns.demo_rule: Mixed code formats. Provider values use SYNTHETIC_PROVIDER placeholders. Code meanings require the source lookup.

files.row_meaning: One synthetic code occurrence for a patient and encounter.

files.name: codified_data_monthly_fake_data.csv

columns.name: EMPI
columns.meaning: Patient identifier. Real EMPI is sensitive and stays on the source server. 真实EMPI需保留在源服务器。
columns.demo_rule: Generated placeholder with one-to-one mapping to Patient_num. No real EMPI used.

columns.name: Patient_num
columns.meaning: Corresponding patient identifier. 对应的患者编号。
columns.demo_rule: Same generated ID as raw PATIENT_NUM.

columns.name: month
columns.meaning: Calendar month in which the code or CUI occurred. 发生月份。

columns.name: year
columns.meaning: Calendar year in which the code or CUI occurred. 发生年份。
columns.demo_rule: 2019–2025, an illustrative period, not the confirmed cohort coverage.

columns.name: Rollup_Code
columns.meaning: Code after rollup for codified data. 汇总后的codified代码。
columns.demo_rule: RXNORM, PheCode, and LOINC format examples. Use the source codified mapping dictionary for real meanings.

columns.name: N
columns.meaning: Number of occurrences of this Rollup_Code for this patient in this month. 该患者该月该代码出现次数。
columns.demo_rule: Positive integer 1–20. 70% of draws use 1–3, otherwise 4–20. Demonstration probabilities only.

files.row_meaning: One synthetic patient, month, year, and Rollup_Code count.
